change: Added 'Anterior Deltoids' to primary shoulders latins. Shoulder circles involve full circular motion both forward and backward, engaging all three deltoid heads. The original omitted the anterior head, which is active during the forward arc of the circle. Rotator Cuff and Traps/Rhomboids as stabilizers confirmed.

Moved oblique (External Obliques + Internal Obliques) from secondary to primary. Research confirms the obliques are a primary stretch target alongside the lats in a side-lying lateral stretch. Posterior Deltoid (Lats secondary) retained as secondary stabilizer stretch.
